name: Saotome Maria
source:
A one-of-a-kind with an overwhelming presence, always with an unwavering desire to rise to the top. Her stage performances, sweet singing voice, outstanding acting ability, and outstanding looks have created a large and enthusiastic fan base.

However, in their life together, the three of them are completely different people from the one on stage, as they are always at each other's throats, playing with each other, and sometimes spoiling each other.

However, this is the true face of Maria Saotome, which she never shows to anyone except her younger sister, Marimo.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=681924]getchu[/url]]
